categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou Kaierda Welding Robot Co., Ltd. primarily operates in industrial welding equipment and industrial robots. Its product portfolio includes industrial welding equipment, industrial robots, and robot-specific welding devices. The company also focuses on humanoid robots as a new strategic development direction.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes core technologies in industrial robot control, robot body technology, servo welding technology, and digital inverter welding technology. It develops robot controllers based on industrial computers using WinOS, RTOS, and EtherCAT, enabling high precision and flexible upgrades. The company also pioneers servo welding and ultra-low spatter welding technologies, and integrates laser welding systems with advanced control algorithms. Production follows a make-to-order model supported by ERP systems for coordination.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kaierda serves industries such as automotive (including new energy vehicles), electric bicycles, medical devices, heavy industry, shipbuilding, metal furniture manufacturing, and arc additive manufacturing. Its customers include both domestic and international manufacturers, with ODM clients like ESAB Group. The company targets mid-to-high-end markets and focuses on expanding its industrial robot and welding equipment customer base.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a strong domestic sales network centered in East China and expanding nationwide. Overseas sales account for about 11.5% of revenue, mainly through ODM partnerships. Key international markets include countries served by clients like ESAB in India, Brazil, and the Middle East.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kaierda operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the industrial robot and welding equipment supply chain. It manufactures robot arms, controllers, and welding devices, while sourcing robot whole machines externally, notably from Yaskawa Electric Corporation. The company integrates components into complete robot welding systems and sells finished products to end users and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in robot control algorithms, servo welding, ultra-low spatter welding, laser welding integration, and humanoid robot core components. It invests heavily in innovation, with 6.76% of revenue allocated to R&D in 2024, and holds numerous patents. Strategic initiatives include expanding robot product lines, enhancing servo welding technology applications, and developing humanoid robots and collaborative robots with advanced human-machine interaction.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of industrial robots, robot-specific welding equipment, and industrial welding devices. Sales channels include a combination of dealer networks (about 80% of revenue), direct sales for large or specialized customers, and ODM manufacturing for international clients. The company also earns income from after-sales services and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Kaierda competes with international leaders such as Yaskawa Electric, Panasonic, Fronius, and ESAB in the high-end welding and industrial robot markets. It positions itself as a leading domestic high-tech enterprise with strong R&D capabilities and competitive pricing, focusing on domestic market share growth and import substitution. The company is recognized as a vice-chair unit in industry associations and has contributed to national standards.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Kaierda achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 557 million, a 15.66% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 31.24 million, up 25.61%. The company maintains a solid asset base with total assets around RMB 1.18 billion. R&D investment increased by 16.33%, supporting sustained growth and innovation. The company has a stable shareholder base with over 6,800 shareholders.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kaierda emphasizes advanced core technologies, cost-effective servo welding solutions, and flexible, software-upgradable robot controllers based on industrial computers. Its products offer high precision, reduced operational costs (e.g., lower protective gas usage), and enhanced ease of use with features like drag teaching and intelligent welding process matching. The company’s strong patent portfolio and continuous innovation provide competitive differentiation in the domestic and international markets.
